name: KYC starts
definition: People who open the KYC flow.
gap: kyc_started with person id, session id, timestamp, country, app version, channel
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Recorded decisions
definition: User records with a final decision in the extract (one per user_reference).
gap: Whether a record is a first, latest or final attempt is not stated
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Approval rate among recorded decisions
definition: Approved (PASSED or APPROVED) ÷ recorded decisions. The headline metric of this analysis.
gap: Not the start-to-finish completion rate: starts, abandonment and attempts are not in the data
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Rejection rate
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Unresolved warning rate
definition: WARNING ÷ recorded decisions. Later review outcome not in the extract.
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Completion rate (start to terminal state)
definition: Starts that reach a terminal state (approved, finally rejected, or abandoned for 7 days) within 7 days of start.
gap: kyc_started, step events, terminal decision, abandonment rule
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Eventual approval within 7 days
definition: Starts approved on any attempt within 7 days of the first start.
gap: Person id across attempts, attempt number, timestamps, review dispositions
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Abandonment rate
definition: Starts with no submission within 7 days.
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Retry rate and retry approval
definition: Share of unsuccessful first attempts that retry, and their approval.
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Manual-review outcomes
definition: Approval and turnaround of cases sent to review.
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Time to completion
definition: Median minutes from start to terminal decision.
gap: Timestamps with time of day on start and decision
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Execution-error rate
definition: Unsuccessful decisions whose primary reason is TECHNICAL_ERROR ÷ recorded decisions.
approved_by: Proposed: Data & Analytics with the metric owner

name: Fraud-signal rate
definition: Unsuccessful decisions whose primary reason is a manipulation or fake label ÷ recorded decisions. Not adjudicated.
